news.title_en: Largan and AUO Spark Single-Mode vs Multi-Mode Dispute! Peng Shuang-lang: Earnings Call Is Earnings Call, What's 'Holding a Dharma Assembly'?
news.summary_en: Largan （3008） Chairman Lin En-ping Recently Stated at Earnings Call That Micro LED in Silicon Photonics Is 'Unlikely,' Mocked by Outsiders as 'Helping AUO Hold a Dharma Assembly.' In Response, AUO （2409） Chairman Peng Shuang-lang Expressed Dissatisfaction, Saying That While It Might Have Been Said in Jest Initially, the Move Causes Significant Harm to the Company, Shareholders, and the Market, and Is Actually Unnecessary.

news.title: Credo新品助陣＋彭双浪駁林恩平觀點 友達靠 Micro LED 衝 CPO 還有戲
news.summary: 大立光（3008）董事長林恩平日前一席Micro LED切入CPO「不可行」的談話，引發市場議論。友達（2409）董事長彭双浪出面高喊「應該是誤解」，強調技術各有優劣，加上輝達高速傳輸關鍵夥伴Credo端出微發光架構新品助陣，透露友達與富采（3714）、鼎元（2426）等泛友達集團成員以Micro LED攻CPO不僅還有戲，更已展開總動員出擊。
news.title_en: Credo new product assists + Peng Shuang-lang refutes Lin En-ping's view: AUO relies on Micro LED to push CPO still has a chance
news.summary_en: Largan Precision（3008） Chairman Lin En-ping's recent remarks that Micro LED entry into CPO is "not feasible" sparked market discussion. AUO（2409） Chairman Peng Shuang-lang came out shouting "should be a misunderstanding," emphasizing each technology has its pros and cons. In addition, NVIDIA's high-speed transmission key partner Credo launched a micro-emission architecture new product to assist, revealing that AUO and FocalTech（3714）, Dynapack（2426） and other AUO group members are not only still in the game attacking CPO with Micro LED, but have also launched a full-scale mobilization.

news.summary_en: Taiwan stocks today （15） day suffered foreign investors massive withdrawal, weighted index closed plunging 1655.96 points, creating history's 6 largest closing drop, breaching 47000 point threshold. Foreign investors single day slashed 302555000000 yuan, refreshing Taiwan stock history's largest net sell record. After market, TWSE announced buy/sell details, heavyweight king TSMC （2330） suffered foreign net sell 34100 shares; memory stock Powerchip （6770） even more cut over 90000 shares; however foreign investors contrarian increased Unified （1216） over 26400 shares as net buy leader, also Mega Financial （2886）, SinoPac Financial （2890） and other 4 financial stocks entered net buy list, capital flows show two sides. 《Full article...》

news.title: 因應歐盟 CRA 新規 研華攜手 DEKRA 德凱簽署 MOU
news.summary: 隨著歐盟《網路韌性法案》（Cyber Resilience Act, CRA）逐步進入實施階段，資安合規正成為工業設備與邊緣 AI 產品進入全球市場的重要門檻。研華（2395）宣布攜手全球領先的檢驗、檢測與驗證機構DEKRA德凱，結合雙方在工業運算、資安測試與全球認證的專業，協助終端應用客戶與系統整合商從產品設計階段即導入資安要求，加速因應歐盟CRA法規要求與IEC 62443標準等規範，降低合規風險並縮短產品進入全球市場的時程。
news.title_en: In response to EU CRA new regulations, Advantech partners with DEKRA to sign MOU
news.summary_en: As the EU's Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) gradually enters implementation phase, cybersecurity compliance is becoming a critical threshold for industrial equipment and edge AI products entering global markets. Advantech （2395） announced partnership with global leading testing, inspection and certification body DEKRA, combining both parties' expertise in industrial computing, security testing and global certification, to help end-application customers and system integrators introduce security requirements from product design stage, accelerate compliance with EU CRA regulations and IEC 62443 standards, reducing compliance risks and shortening time-to-market for products globally.

items.title: 緯創醫學攜長庚科技大學 共育 AI 智慧照護人才 推動智慧健康創新應用
items.summary: 面對超高齡社會帶來的照護需求，以及人工智慧與數位科技在健康照護領域的快速發展，如何將科技創新轉化為實際照護應用，已成為產業發展的重要課題。緯創（3231）旗下緯創醫學科技股份有限公司20日與長庚科技大學於長庚科大林口校區簽署合作備忘錄（MOU），共同推動「AI賦能高齡暨健康產業人才培訓精進計畫」，整合產業實務與學術資源，深化智慧健康、高齡照護及數位健康領域合作。雙方將透過人才培育、研究合作及場域實踐，培養具備AI應用能力之健康照護人才，並共同推動創新科技於健康照護領域之應用與發展。

items.title: 緯創營收衝3兆！從猛投 IoT 碰壁到 AI 占大宗 吳思本揭轉型一課
items.summary: 緯創資通（3231）2026年營收將破3兆元，比去年業績翻了一倍，企業投資（CVC）辦公室副總經理吳思本表示，緯創近2年業績成長是因為AI爆發，其實早在2018年緯創就跟NVIDIA專案合作，但若非2022年GPT橫空出世，專案能否堅持10年也說不準，這也凸顯現在企業最大挑戰在於如何探索找到「未知的未來」。

news.title: 萬家福 UNIDESIGN 品牌擴大 商品上架80款、非籠飼蛋熱銷破2,370萬元
news.summary: 統一（1216）UNIDESIGN系列商品持續擴大萬家福、樂家康自有品牌布局，從食品、清潔用品到居家日用品，透過兼顧品質與價格的商品策略，帶動消費者購買熱度。自7月起，系列商品陸續恢復供應多款人氣品項，並持續擴充商品陣容，截至10月已推出80款商品。其中，非籠飼平飼新鮮蛋7至9月業績突破2,370萬元，居系列熱銷排行榜之冠；純水、冷凍水餃及衛生紙等民生商品也展現強勁銷售動能，反映消費者對高性價比日常用品的需求。
news.title_en: Wanjiafu UNIDESIGN brand expands, products on shelves 80 items, cage-free eggs hot sales exceed 23700000 yuan
news.summary_en: Uni-President （1216） UNIDESIGN series products continue to expand Wanjiafu, Lejiakang own brand layout, from food, cleaning supplies to household daily necessities, through product strategy balancing quality and price, driving consumer purchasing heat. Since 7 month, series products successively restore supply of many popular items, and continue to expand product lineup, as of 10 month have launched 80 items. Among them, cage-free free-range fresh eggs 7 to 9 month performance exceeds 23700000 yuan, ranking top of series best-selling list; pure water, frozen dumplings and toilet paper etc. daily necessities also show strong sales momentum, reflecting consumer demand for high cost-performance daily necessities.

news.title_en: Taiwan Cement Shalu Water Distribution Center Small Hydropower Plant wins first 'Outstanding Diverse Green Energy Award'
news.summary_en: The first 'Outstanding Diverse Green Energy Award' ceremony was held on October 16 morning at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition 1 Hall. Taiwan Cement （1326） won the 'Outstanding Installation System Award - Diverse Energy' from the Ministry of Economic Affairs Energy Bureau for its 'Shalu Water Distribution Center Small Hydropower Plant', with Taiwan Cement Vice President Wang Chi-chou attending to accept the award. The company stated that this award demonstrates Taiwan Cement's technical strength in integrating hydropower, water supply safety, and intelligent operations and maintenance, and establishes a demonstration model for creating green energy value from existing water supply facilities.

news.summary_en: Google's Quantum AI team achieves key breakthrough in quantum computing, reducing quantum error rate by approx 40x, expected to significantly cut hardware costs for building practical quantum systems, accelerating commercialization. Among Taiwanese hardware makers, Quanta （2382）, Foxconn （2317）, Inventec （2324）, Kinpo （2312） and other major firms have invested in related research; in post-quantum cryptography, Chunghwa Telecom （6163）, Phison （6590） and other vendors are participating.
